title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 7
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en Starlight Inc y el líder the IT Director.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 7)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en Starlight Inc usando CloudCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the IT Director.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of Starlight Inc's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are installing routers in the server rack. B) They are replacing the computer monitors. C) The data center is empty. D) They are coding a mobile application.
questions.explanation: Se observa a los ingenieros de sistemas conectando el cableado estructurado en el rack de servidores.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi David, did you check the network upgrade plan from Starlight Inc?
W: Yes. The IT Director wants all cloud access permissions registered in CloudCRM by tonight.
M: Good. That will secure our databases before the system migration.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in CloudCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to CloudCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Systems Engineers
*From:* IT Department
*Subject: Network Migration & CloudCRM Permissions*

Please note that starting next Monday, we are migrating to our new fiber database. A security setup session will be held this Sunday at 4:30 PM in the Conference Annex Room.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next Sunday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to CloudCRM'.
